usage: music-tagger path-for [-h] --evidence EVIDENCE [--root ROOT] [-o OUT]

Compute library destination paths for album files.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --evidence EVIDENCE  Evidence JSON from `read`.
  --root ROOT          Library root (default: /mnt/synology/media/music).
  -o, --out OUT        Output JSON file (prints digest to stdout).
